name: claude-pets
description: Pets that live above the Claude Code prompt and act out what Claude is doing, plus a prompt-cache meter.

plugins.name: pets
plugins.description: Four faceless pets in starlight line art above the prompt: they read, plant, dig, fetch and fly along with Claude, panic at risky commands, raise young ones for helper agents, and sleep between turns.

plugins.name: prompt-cache-control
plugins.description: Prompt-cache meter under the pets: hit rate, read/wrote/new tokens, a countdown to the cache's expiry, and your 5-hour and weekly plan windows. By Daniel Avila (claude-code-templates, MIT), with small changes so it sits under the pets.
